title: Signals [Ctrl+C, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+D]
description:
# Signals
Signals are messages sent to running programs. You send them with keyboard shortcuts:

## Ctrl+C - SIGINT (Interrupt)
Stops the current program. Use it when something is stuck:
```bash
ping google.com
# Ctrl+C to stop
```

## Ctrl+Z - SIGTSTP (Suspend)
Pauses the program and sends it to the background:
```bash
ping google.com
# Ctrl+Z to pause
fg              # bring it back
```

## Ctrl+D - EOF (End of File)
Tells the program there's no more input. Not a signal - it closes stdin:
```bash
cat
# type some text
# Ctrl+D to end
```
